item.title: Edmonton R User Group Meetup: Futureverse - A Unifying Parallelization Framework in R for Everyone
item.description: Below are the slides from my presentation at the Edmonton R User Group Meetup (YEGRUG) on May 22, 2023: Title: Futureverse - A Unifying Parallelization Framework in R for Everyone Speaker: Henrik Bengtsson Slides: HTML, PDF (46 slides) Video: official recording (~60 minutes) Thank you Péter Sólymos and the YEGRUG for the invitate and the opportunity! /Henrik Links YEGRUG: https://yegrug.github.io/ Futureverse website: https://www.futureverse.org/ future package CRAN, GitHub, pkgdown
